title: Luma Travel — priority-four journey maps, 7 stages each (P09 Halina, P14 Bernard, P04 Reuben, P12 Jaden) — opportunities benchmarked
superseded_reason: User (/journey-map skill invocation) asked for an interactive version with data-visualization graphics. v3 adds an overview (emotion sparklines + pain/confidence heatmap, ADR-021 dataviz layer) and converts each persona section to a native <details> disclosure. All v2 grounded-opportunity content (ART-039 citations) carried forward unchanged.

method.skill: journey-map (customer-journey-mapping base + CoForge extensions §16, loaded this session)
method.claim_format: Evidenced [ART-030 § section] for pain/behaviour claims; Evidenced [ART-039 § persona] for opportunity claims (new in v2) — the two are deliberately different citations, because a pain is evidence about the persona and an opportunity is evidence about the market, and blurring them would misstate what's actually grounded
method.gate_b: no raw hex outside :root token block (values match design-system/tokens/tokens.json — bone #eeece6, ink #041222, coral #f15b40), no raw px outside the token/spacing scale, zero minted [E-nnn] IDs, synthetic banner present in header and footer, Anek Latin for prose, Source Code Pro for labels/IDs/citations, tabular-nums class available for any numeral runs

structure.selection: Same four personas as ART-035 and ART-038 v1, unchanged in v2.
structure.one_map_per_persona: Each of the 4 <section class="pj"> blocks is a complete, self-contained one-actor journey map (diagram-cartographer hard rule: one actor per map) bundled into a single document — same bundling precedent as ART-035 (4 personas, one file) and ART-036 (zip package).

v2_changes.what_changed: 8 Opportunities cells (2 per persona — the two stages carrying each persona's main pain) rewritten with inline [ART-039 § persona] citations grounding each opportunity in named market precedent, instead of stating design reasoning uncited. Everything else in the payload (Goal/Actions/Thoughts/Emotion/Pain points/Evidence/Confidence rows, all 4 emotion-curve SVGs, header, footer provenance list) is unchanged from v1.
v2_changes.what_did_not_change: The other ~20 Opportunities cells that were already '—' (no grounded pain at that stage) remain '—'. No new opportunity was invented to fill them; ART-039 only benchmarked the 4 already-populated cells per persona's main pain, so only those were touched.
v2_changes.honesty_preserved: P14 Bernard's revised opportunity explicitly states that no market precedent was found for his specific failure mode (confusable boarding-pass pair) — the benchmark's finding was an evidenced absence, and v2 carries that absence forward rather than substituting an adjacent-sounding citation.

notes: No quotes used anywhere — evidence ledger holds zero entries, ADR-024 in force.
P09 (Disabled/Assisted segment) carries the same grounding caveat ART-030 §2 states for that register. Coral top accent applied only to this segment per the visual spec.

v1 (same date) is superseded by this version — see v1/manifest.json for the supersession note. v1's other 10 personas (P01–P03, P05–P08, P10, P11, P13) were dropped before v1 shipped, at user direction; not reintroduced here, out of scope for this revision.
Figma package deferred pending Gate A sign-off on this HTML, per journey-map skill §16 CoForge extensions ('Human approves the HTML before any Figma package is produced').
